items.text: Hey everyone! Patch 1.032 is now live! With this patch, we've vastly improved the game's stability once again!
Fixed a bug that would cause crashes later in the game
Resolved several memory-related issues, which reduced the game's memory footprint

Added a launch option to skip shader compilation. If Soulslinger launches with a black screen for you, this option can help launch the game! It will cause a bit of stuttering when something is displayed for the first time during gameplay, but in about 10-15 minutes of play, should become a smooth experience!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44325770/6b8fb280ba0bbb441b87132c719c72cf90c59d9c.jpg"]
Heya Soulslingers!
We’ve just rolled out Update 1.031, and this one has some serious under-the-hood improvements that you should feel right away:
⚙️ Major Performance Improvements
We’ve rebuilt shader compilation from the ground up, making it more thorough and precise. What does that mean for you? Fewer hiccups, smoother gameplay, and a more consistent experience overall.

On top of that, we’ve done major optimizations to rendering and enemy systems, allowing the game to handle intense combat situations with far less performance loss. Things can now get a lot more chaotic without your framerate taking a hit.
🛠️ Bug Fixes
As always, we’ve also squashed some nasty bugs, with the main focus being fixing a crash that made life much worse while playing in the Outskirts.
CHANGELOG FOR VERSION 1.031
Rebuilt shader compilation from scratch to be more thorough and precise, resulting in an overall smoother experience when playing
Major optimizations across the board regarding rendering and enemies, the game can now handle a lot more action without performance loss
Map loading takes a lot less time now
Adjusted several texture sizes to improve performance in the Land of Memories, Haven and the Graveyard
Optimized rendering across the entire game to reduce stutters
The level of weapons found in the Graveyard and Outskirts realms will now be slightly higher
Weapons found in the Trauma realm are now at a significantly higher level than the rest of the game
Fixed a crash that could occur in the Outskirts
Fixed a bug where you could fall out of the Haven map
Fixed a bug related to coins that would often cause severe stuttering when coins were dropped
Fixed a bug where enemy HP bars were updated even when hidden, reducing performance

This update is another step toward polishing Soulslinger to the level it deserves. Thank you all for continuing to report issues and share feedback — it genuinely helps us make the game better with every patch.
See you in the afterlife,
The Elder Games Team 💀🔥

items.text: Greetings Soulslingers!

releases.displayName: New Update incoming soon: Overhauled Combat Flow, visual Upgrades, and more!

items.text: Heya Soulslingers!

We’re excited to announce that the next update for Soulslinger: Envoy of Death is just around the corner, and this time, it’s all about YOU, the players! Based on your feedback, we will be making several impactful changes and additions to enhance your experience. Here’s what’s new:

First up, combat flow will receive a major overhaul! You’ll soon be able to interrupt reloading and swap weapons on the fly, giving you more flexibility and control in the heat of battle. Combined with vastly improved weapon handling, accuracy, and animations, every shot and reload will feel smoother and more precise than ever.

We’re also expanding the game world with new arenas being added to both the Land of Memories and the Outskirts. These new battlegrounds are designed to challenge your skills in fresh and exciting ways, ensuring that no two runs feel the same.
In Haven, you’ll have even more reasons to linger. New conversations with NPCs will provide deeper lore and opportunities to connect with Death, Lady Valerie, and Helene.

Finally, we’re putting a huge focus on visual clarity and polish. Numerous VFX will be reworked, with unnecessary elements cleaned up or removed, and higher-quality effects introduced. The result will be a battlefield that’s easier to read, letting you focus on the action without sacrificing clarity.

This update is a labor of love, shaped by your voices, and we can’t wait for you to dive back into the Soulslinger experience. Thank you for your feedback and continued support — it inspires us to keep making the game better with every release!
So long, friends!
Ede out!

releases.displayName: New Early Access Update releasing this Week: New Weapon, new Enemies, new Boss!

items.text: Heya Soulslingers!

In just a few days, Soulslinger: Envoy of Death will receive its largest update yet, and we can't wait for you to dive in! The second half of the Outskirts realm will finally arrive, packed with treacherous new arenas, a host of never-before-seen enemies, and surprise encounters that break up regular gameplay.

We’re also introducing a brand-new weapon — the Wraithshot. A powerful addition to your arsenal, the Wraithshot schematics can be found after defeating the Revenant Sheriff boss. This gun is devastatingly strong, but its strength is balanced by the fact that it needs to be reloaded after each shot. But if that shot is used well, it can tear through the entire battlefield!

But that’s not all. We’re thrilled to finally introduce the game's main villain, Victor. With him comes a brand-new challenge: Rush Encounters. Victor intervenes in regular battles, summoning five elite enemy types, each more brutal than the last. These enemies can phase through walls and unleash devastating area-of-effect attacks, ramping up the intensity like never before.

Lastly, prepare to confront one of your deadliest opponents yet — the nightmarish Sentinel. This grotesque boss awaits you at the end of the Outskirts realm, wielding soul-devouring powers that pose an entirely new kind of threat. Do you have what it takes to bring it down and survive?

And this is just the tip of the iceberg — it’s not even a quarter of the changes and new features coming your way! After four months in the making, we at Elder Games are beyond excited to finally bring you this massive update!
So long, friends!
Ede out!

items.text: Howdy Soulslingers!

New unexplored lands have just shown up in Limbo, and now Death needs your help, Soulslingers, to vanquish the Cartel lurking in the Outskirts! To help you on your way, you are given a new weapon, ‘Silver Defiler,’ and a new set of skills, 'Desolate Essence,' that might prove useful.
Welcome to the Outskirts!

With one part of Limbo relatively safe, Death sends Soulslinger deeper into Cartel territory to hunt another lieutenant. The landscape shifts even further into that of the Wild West, reflecting the Cartel’s leader’s solid hold on the area. These are the 'Outskirts' - the outer rim of Cartel territory, dominated by deadly gunslingers and monstrous wraiths.
Silver Defiler
A weapon with a curved projectile that creates a poisonous puddle on the ground upon impact, causing devastating AOE damage to all enemies in the area.
Desolate Essence

With the Desolate Essence, you can summon an allied golem that will rush to the closest target and aid you for a limited time. Or you can lower your dash cooldown so you can move around a lot quicker.
Revenant Sheriff and new enemies

A new challenge awaits you when venturing around in the Outskirts with five new types of enemies. You will also encounter the Revenant Sheriff, who might stop you in your tracks as you travel deeper into Limbo!

releases.displayName: Next Early Access Update delayed till early July; what'll be included?

items.text: Heya Soulslingers!

A Soulslinger Early Access roadmap update was originally planned for June, but we've decided to postpone it until the beginning of July. For the amount of content that is coming with the update, we just need the extra time to be able to deliver it all at the usual quality.
We have adapted the Early Access Roadmap artwork on the product page accordingly.
But what is it exactly that you can expect from this upcoming update?
You will be able to enter the new realm called 'Outskirts' and make it to the next miniboss (equivalent to the King's Guard in the previous realm)
New enemies with brand new enemy types, different AI than before, some of them are smarter or behave very differently from what you've seen so far
A new voiced NPC with an important role, main cut-scene and lots of dialogue
Two new spell classes, one of them is a new essence, the other is tied to Nia, Soulslinger's love from real life
A new pre-rendered cinematic giving a bit of insight into who Soulslinger used to be in real life
A new weapon
The black crystal resource required at the Well of Tears, as well as the next two Well upgrades
You can also expect massive balance changes, eg. the projectile barrage in the Graveyard will be much more bearable and Healing Shrines will occur more frequently (among many other changes).
Stay tuned! It won't take too long until the update will be available! Soulslinger's promise! 🤠
So long, friends!
Ede out!
Happy Friday, Soulslingers!

As promised in yesterday's teaser post, we have released the update 0.452, introducing new ways to upgrade and handle weapons. You will now be able to use two weapons and easily swap between them with the (TAB) key even during a fight, and every weapon now has unique weapon-specific perks and levels, creating new ways for you to play the game!
We also made it easier to obtain the 'The Night Quartet' and, as a result, have added a new Relic that will be awarded by defeating the Countess.

With this update, we are also bringing a lot of quality-of-life changes and improvements to FOV, VFX, and much more that the community has put forward. We thank you for your support. Please let us know what you think about the new changes!

items.text: Greetings Soulslingers!

We have just released our first major update, The Forgotten Graveyard Update. In this patch, we are introducing a completely new realm, a new boss, a new weapon, new enemies to defeat and much more. We also made some balancing changes and fixed some bugs.
Forgotten Graveyard

Welcome to the Forgotten Graveyard! Are you ready to face the challenges that await you in a realm controlled by The Countess? Be prepared to fight ferocious monsters that you have never faced before to reach her.

But if you manage to defeat her, you will be rewarded with her precious weapon, the Night Quartet. It operates differently from the other weapons you were able to use before, as it has a cooldown mechanism. This means that you can fire it as many times as you want without having to reload it, but be cautious about overheating it!
Blood Essence and Spectral Essence

Blood Essence is used for a set of powerful new abilities focused on absorbing the blood and spirits of your opponents to heal yourself, deal more damage, or enhance your ultimate skill. However, some of these abilities are consumed upon use. Utilizing the Blood Essence abilities can give you an edge in challenging battles and help you in seemingly impossible fights.

To obtain Spectral Essence skills, you must venture into the treacherous 'Forgotten Graveyard'. These abilities are unique and powerful, for example, you can unlock explosive homing projectiles that can hunt down your targets and deal massive damage, or trade in your dash for a double jump.
Power Totem

The Power Totem is another new addition to Limbo. You can now spend the tears you've collected on permanent upgrades that will help you in your fight against the Cartel. You can upgrade as much as you want to get even stronger, as there is no end to the Power Totem—however, the cost increases each time.
New realm: the 'Forgotten Graveyard'
Added four new enemies
New boss: 'The Countess' can be defeated at the end of the Forgotten Graveyard
New weapon: the 'Night Quartet' is a cooldown-based 4-shooter that you can loot from the Countess
Added the 'Spectral Essence' and all its related abilities and perks, you can access these in the Forgotten Graveyard
Added the 'Blood Essence' and all its related abilities and perks; you can access these after beating the King's Guard for the first time
You can now construct the 'Power Totem' at Haven; this allows you to upgrade Soulslinger's stats infinitely
You can now construct the 'Orb of the Seer' at Haven, this keeps track of your stats and efficiency
Replaced the visuals of the Poison Bullet explosion with a much better looking and more impactful visual effect
Movement with a gamepad is now based on a curve and has a deadzone, so moving the left or right thumbsticks will now respect the strength of movement
All missing items are now indicated in the Workshop, along with instructions on how to get them
Reduced the length of time dilation caused by the Darkened Moment ability
All AOE dash abilities now trigger 100% of the time
Removed Healing Shards as separate rewards, these became redundant (the Blood Essence has the exact same perk)
Healing Shards can still be acquired as boss rewards or at the challenge arena
Reduced the health of the Cursed King from 9000 to 6000
Reduced the impact circle of the stones thrown by Cartel Brutes
Reduced the gravity of the Ardent Assassin's fireball projectile, making it slightly more effective
Fixed a bug which caused massive stutter at cut-scene transitions when DLSS was enabled
Fixed a bug where the crafting screen status was not immediately updated upon collecting resources from the Bestiary
Fixed a bug where the hidden gate downside obtained with a Death perk would never reset after loading a saved game
Fixed a bug where saving the game immediately after beating the Cursed King would result in a corrupted saved game
Fixed a bug where an empty or corrupted perk would be displayed when picking up a reward
Tons of visual fixes and tweaks to make sure VFX doesn't overwhelm the screen
Improved the map selection algorithm to make sure maps are repeated less frequently
Please let us know what you think!
So long, friends. Have a great time!
Ede out!

items.text: Howdy Soulslingers!
Welcome to the March Developer Update. Today, we would like to give you some more details about some of the new features and content that will arrive soon!

First of all, we’ve made the decision to merge the March and April updates on the Early Access Roadmap, which has given us some extra time to implement and get everything ready. The update is also shaping up to be much larger than initially planned!
So, without further ado, let’s dive right in!
New Realm: The 'Forgotten Graveyard'

Limbo is expanding with a new realm, The 'Forgotten Graveyard', where you will explore new areas and come across new challenges, ferocious monsters, as well as a new boss that will test even the most skilled Soulslingers.
Power Totem

The new Power Totem adds an exciting new dimension to the Limbo experience. You can now spend the tears you collected on permanent upgrades that will help your fight against the cartel. The Power Totem has no end, so you can continue upgrading as much as you want, but it gets more expensive each time!
The Night Quartet

As you venture into the new realm, you might come across a novel firearm called the 'Night Quartet'. This weapon functions a bit differently from the other weapons as it operates on a cooldown mechanism. This means that you can fire it as many times as you like without having to reload, but it is essential to be cautious of overheating!
Blood Essence

Blood Essence gives you several new powerful abilities that allow you to absorb the blood and spirits of your opponents to heal yourself or deal more damage, but it can also be used to enhance your existing ultimate skill. However, some of those abilities are consumed upon using them. Using the Blood Essence abilities can provide you with new ways to approach challenging battles and turn them into victories.

All these new features and a LOT more will be added to our first major update coming in April! In the meantime, if you can't wait to learn more, be sure to join our Discord community, where we often share exclusive sneak peeks!
So long, friends, and see you in the next developer update!
Ede out!
Greetings, Soulslingers!

A brand new update for Soulslinger: Envoy of Death landed a minute ago! Those of you who have been on our Discord channel over the last few days will have noticed the biggest and most obvious change in the 0.426 update in advance: it rebuilts the lighting and color settings of the Land of Memories from scratch.
But the update brings even more features, improvements and fixes to the game, so here is the complete changelog for version 0.426:
Rebuilt the lighting and color settings of the Land of Memories from scratch
Added a bright, noticeable indicator whenever a ranged enemy launches its attack
The Shotgun spread works very differently now, vastly improving the usability of the weapon
Reduced camera sway during ADS
Fixed a bug where the Fire Guard's massive sword strike never dealt damage
Fixed a bug where the flying Wraith's projectile would collide with seemingly nothing and disappear
Fixed the Devourer's Bestiary description
It is no longer possible to set max FPS due to major performance issues this caused
Of course, this is not all we're working on -- behind the scenes, we are cooking new content for y'all! And our first major update isn't terribly far away now! 🙂
Please let me know what you think about the update and its contents! if you have any feedback, please post it in the comments, in the Steam Community or on our Discord server.
So long, friends. Have fun with update 0.426!
Ede out!

items.text: Greetings, Soulslingers!
This is Ede again - right of the depth of the develolpment limbo! 🤠

So, now that our two latest updates added ’Gunplay 2.0’ as well as a bunch of improvements, bugfixes and ADS balancing, it is time to share some more information about upcoming content that will be added to the game in the coming months.

But let's talk about the BESTIARY first! It was added with the last update and is located in Haven. It allows you to check out the enemies of every realm and collect permanent resources upon defeating a new enemy type! This building will be available by default and will provide a boost to your resources early on:

With the second Early Access Roadmap Update in March, we will introduce even more Haven extensions. These are additional buildings that will either be available from the start or ones that you can construct to unlock additional gameplay features:
POWER TOTEM
The Power Totem offers stat upgrades to Soulslinger. As long as you keep farming resources, you can keep upgrading because the Power Totem never runs out of new upgrades!
ORB OF THE SEER
The Orb of the Seer allows you to keep track of your most important stats, such as accuracy rating, furthest segment reached, etc, etc.
In addition to the Haven extensions, we also plan to add the new Blood Essence that introduces new skills focusing on healing and vampirism!
BUT THERE’S MORE!

Excited to find out what other new content is coming for Soulslinger? Here’s a first look at a new realm we plan to introduce soon! This is NOT the second major realm, but an exciting alternate route you can take while traversing the currently available Land of Memories!

We are excited to hear your thoughts and feedback, and we will continue to share more information leading up to the next Early Access Roadmap Update. For even more sneak peeks, you can join our Discord community where we regularly share updates and news.
So long, friends, and see you in the next developer update!
Ede out!
Greetings, Soulslingers!

Increased shotgun efficiency
Reduced the cost of several craftable items
Increased coin pickup radius by 75%
Increased poison damage bonus gained by the Powerful Toxin perk from 40% to 50%
Reduced the Cursed King's health by 10%
Raised shotgun ADS location so it is clear where it is aiming
Fixed several instances of damage texts missing or appearing in the wrong place
Fixed a bug where in the cave arena, enemies could get stuck in a wall next to one of the stairs
Fixed a bug where the King's Guard could be cheesed from a ledge above the arena
Fixed a bug where you could see under the map in the courtyard arena

items.text: Hey friends!
I have uploaded another build of Soulslinger a minute ago, updating the game to version 0.403. Most important: finally with this update the "fatal error" crashes are resolved once and for all!
Here is the list of all changes, fixes and improvements - including those from the two previous version updates:
Resolved fatal error crashes once and for all!
Fixed a bug where some coins were invisible
Fixed a bug where some coins couldn't be picked up and would remain there forever
Fixed a bug where gamepad sensitivity options did not get applied properly
Fixed a bug where certain cut-scene videos would not play
Added a separate controller sensitivity setting to gameplay options
Fixed the bug where the difficult mode relic was never actually unlocked in the Workshop
Fixed a bug where the smash attack of the Fire Guard boss would damage the player even though it hit the poison decoy
Fixed a bug where falling down in the "hanged skeleton" arena could sometimes cause you to respawn within a wall
Fixed the bug where the 'Invert Y' setting was not saved!
Fixed a bug where you could talk to Death even though he was not standing there

Thank you all a ton for reporting bugs and providing me with feedback! ❤️ And please don't stop doing so! I want to make Soulslinger the best possible gaming experience it can be, and it would be awesome to have your further support.
Ede out!

Hey there fellow gunslingers! 🤠

we received so much valuable feedback since the Steam Next Fest: October begun, that it led to the third update for the Soulslinger: Envoy of Death demo! This one is basically a huge map and AI update, with the more detailed fixes and improvements listed below:
Widened most maps and cleaned up collisions so the player and enemies don't get stuck
Completely revamped the AI of ranged enemies (i.e. archer, fire thrower), they should behave in a much more logical way and pose more of a threat
Changed the AI of the basic Swarmer enemy, instead of their unfair dash attack, they will now use a much more telegraphed teleportation to quickly catch up to you
Fixed a bug where using abilities in quick succession prevented some abilities from activating while still wasted their cooldown
Fixed various jumping-related bugs which should result in enemies performing way less unnecessary jumps
Various additional map fixes and improvements

We are happy and grateful for any feedback you share with us, because we want to make Soulslinger: Envoy of Death the best possible gaming experience! Please let us know in the comments, in the Steam Community Hub or in our little online survey - linked HERE.
And if you're having a good time, please do us a favor and click on "Follow" as well as on "Add To Your Wishlist". That would really help us a lot. ❤️
Happy Steam Next Fest to all of you!
Ede out!
Happy Monday, fellow gunslingers! 🤠

Let's keep it short and simple: I've published another major update to the Soulslinger: Envoy of Death demo the last weekend! And instead of making big speeches here, I'll just let the changelog speak for itself:
Game consumes 3-5GB RAM consistently (instead of the previous 8-10GB)
Game runs at 100+ FPS on high-end machines, can even work with a GTX 1060 on medium-high graphics

Instead of all the micro-stutters, we have opted to make the game freeze for 1-2 seconds when travelling through a gate, while we display "LOADING" -- this makes you wait a bit at each travel, but makes the game a lot smoother in all other situations!
Ability cooldown is now time-based instead of kill-based, allowing you to reuse abilities multiple times even throughout a single battle!
Each battle now consists of multiple enemy waves
Added a melee attack (default key: V) that deals moderate damage and pushes enemies back a bit
Added invert mouse option
Tons of bugfixes
At the moment, we are aware of a "Fatal error!" crash that can occur sometimes, we are currently in the process of investigating this. Expect a hotfix soon that will resolve this!

In the case you played the demo already, it would be awesome if you could give it another try and let us know what you think about the improvements. And if you haven't played the demo yet, that's great! Please play it and let us know what you think.
Either here in the comments, in the Steam Community Hub, on Discord or through our feedback survey - the banner guides the way:
As always: No feedback will remain unread. Promise! And if you liked the demo, please consider wishlisting and following us here on Steam. This would actually help us a lot! ❤️
Talk to you very soon, friends. Have a great time!
Ede out!
